title: Artifact-to-Capability: Diagnosing Breaks in Capability Formation of Self-Evolving Agents in a Controlled Environment
title_zh: 从工件到能力：在受控环境中诊断自进化智能体能力形成的中断

paragraphs.en: Self-evolving agents write interaction experience into artifacts and reuse them in later tasks. Most work supports such methods with three proxy signals: artifacts accumulate, behavior changes once they are loaded, and metrics rise. We call this signal-based evaluation. What these signals are meant to indicate, however, has not been defined. To fill this gap, we define capability formation from artifacts as five sequentially dependent properties, two of which form a checkpoint for capability formation, and introduce three-scale diagnosis, which judges these properties at the state, game, and lineage levels. In freestyle Gomoku, Reflexion, Voyager, and DGM evolve with the same base model and all show the three signals, yet each exhibits a distinct capability-formation break. Reflexion shows a legalization gain: its pass rate rises only because more of its moves are legal. Voyager shows a compositional override: components that are sound on their own combine to miss all 20 available one-move wins. DGM shows loss-only drift: after passing the checkpoint, later versions only lose passing states. These counterexamples show that signal-based evaluation cannot determine whether a capability has formed.

paragraphs.en: Self-evolving agents generate artifacts through interaction with an environment—textual reflections, executable skills, or code—and inject them into a harness so that experience can be reused across tasks ( Xi et al., 2023 ) . Work in this area typically argues that a method is effective using three signals: artifacts accumulate, behavior changes once they are loaded, and accuracy, pass rate, or evolutionary score rises. We call this signal-based evaluation . All three signals are proxies for capability. None directly tests whether a changed behavior advances the task, whether an established effect is overturned by another part of the system, or whether later evolution builds on what has been gained. More fundamentally, what “effective” should refer to has not been defined. We therefore ask: what verifiable task capability do the artifacts a system generates and reuses actually leave behind?

paragraphs.en: Prior work has argued that endpoint performance on a single episode cannot characterize self-evolution, and has turned to long-horizon task streams, capability trajectories across frozen versions, or separate analyses of reflections, tool libraries, and transfer (Section 2 ). These analyses still take episodes, versions, or tools as their objects. Answering our question instead requires taking the transition from artifact to capability itself as the object: observing how a single action changes, whether that change survives in actual decision making, and whether it carries over across versions. Such observations are hard to make in open-ended tasks, where states cannot be replayed exactly, the correctness of an action lacks an independent criterion, and environmental noise and unstructured states confound attribution. We therefore study the question in a controlled environment.
paragraphs.zh: 已有研究指出，单次回合（episode）上的端点表现无法刻画自我演化，因此转向了长程任务流、跨冻结版本的能力轨迹，或对反思、工具库与迁移的单独分析（见第 2 节）。 这些分析仍然以回合、版本或工具为研究对象。 而要回答我们的问题，则需要将「从产物到能力」的转变本身作为对象：观察单个动作如何变化、该变化是否在实际决策中得以留存，以及它是否能跨版本延续。 这样的观察在开放式任务中很难进行，因为在这些任务中，状态无法被精确重放，动作的正确性缺乏独立的判据，且环境噪声与非结构化状态会干扰归因。 因此，我们在一个受控环境中研究这一问题。

paragraphs.en: Such an environment must make states replayable, task effects rule-judged, and games and versions fully recorded (Section 4.1 ). Inspired by ( Li et al., 2023 ) , who study world-model representations with controlled board-game sequences, we use freestyle Gomoku (Gomoku without forbidden-move restrictions) as a “microscope” for self-evolving mechanisms. Gomoku meets these requirements. Simple rules do not make the task simple. The agent reads the board only as a sequence of coordinates and must reconstruct spatial relations along rows, columns, and diagonals on its own (Figure 1 ); without memory, about half of the model’s moves land on occupied points, which leaves real room for evolution to improve.
paragraphs.zh: 这样的环境必须使状态可重放、任务效果可按规则判定、并且对棋局和版本进行完整记录（第4.1节）。 受（Li et al., 2023）通过受控棋类序列研究世界模型表征的工作启发，我们使用自由五子棋（无禁手规则限制的五子棋）作为研究自进化机制的“显微镜”。 五子棋满足这些要求。 规则简单并不意味着任务简单。 智能体只能以坐标序列的形式读取棋盘，必须自行重建行、列和对角线上的空间关系（图1）；在没有记忆的情况下，模型约有一半的落子会落在已被占据的点上，这为进化改进留下了真实的提升空间。

paragraphs.en: In this environment, we define capability formation as five properties that an artifact passes through in sequence, forming the Artifact-to-Capability diagnostic framework (Section 3.1 ). An artifact must first form and enter decision making, and then change actions. A change is neutral in itself: it must also produce a positive effect without undermining effects already established, and only when both hold has a capability formed. Later evolution should then extend it. The five properties are judged at three scales—states, games, and lineages—which we call three-scale diagnosis (Section 4 ).

paragraphs.en: We let Reflexion ( Shinn et al., 2023 ) , Voyager ( Wang et al., 2023 ) , and DGM ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) evolve autonomously with the same base model, environment, and opponents, then freeze and diagnose them. To show that signal-based evaluation cannot establish capability formation, a single counterexample suffices: a system that shows all three signals but has not formed a capability. We present three, each breaking at a different property—three capability-formation breaks . Reflexion shows a legalization gain : its memories make the model play fewer illegal moves but do not make it choose better among legal ones. Voyager shows a compositional override : each component is sound on its own, but in combination the calling script blocks the opponent and returns early at conflict states, overriding an established win; across 20 games, it completes five at none of its immediate-win states. DGM shows loss-only drift : OB-3 passes the checkpoint, but later versions only lose passing states, and the last barely changes behavior. That the three breaks fall on different properties also shows that no property can stand in for another.

paragraphs.en: Findings. We present three counterexamples in Reflexion, Voyager, and DGM: all three signals are present, yet the diagnosis detects a legalization gain, a compositional override, and loss-only drift, breaking at task-relation realization, boundary-safe reuse, and capability extension, respectively. paragraphs.en: Prior work has examined self-evolving agents and the roles of their artifacts from several angles. Process-oriented evaluations track performance changes along checkpoints or task streams. EvoPathBench freezes successive artifact checkpoints and uses paired evaluations with artifacts enabled and disabled on held-out episodes to test whether performance depends on them ( Lin et al., 2026a ) . Agent Plasticity measures self-improvement at each checkpoint in environments including board games; using LLM-generated observational annotations, it distinguishes two bottlenecks—failure to reuse a relevant artifact and failure even after reuse—and notes that controlled interventions such as removal or replacement could further separate these mechanisms ( Singh et al., 2026 ) . Lin et al. (2026b) trace the limited gains of weaker models to artifacts that are either not loaded or not followed after loading.
paragraphs.zh: 已有工作从多个角度考察了自进化智能体及其产物的作用。 面向过程的评估在检查点或任务流上追踪性能变化。 EvoPathBench 冻结连续的产物检查点，并在保留剧集上使用启用与禁用产物的成对评估，以检验性能是否依赖于这些产物（Lin et al., 2026a）。 Agent Plasticity 在包括棋盘游戏在内的环境中衡量每个检查点上的自我改进；它利用大语言模型生成的观察性标注，区分了两种瓶颈——未能复用相关产物，以及复用后仍然失败——并指出诸如移除或替换等受控干预可以进一步分离这些机制（Singh et al., 2026）。Lin et al. （2026b）将较弱模型的有限增益归因于产物未被加载，或加载后未被遵循。

paragraphs.en: Other work documents negative effects of artifacts: when skills with overlapping functions coexist, conflicts arise mainly when the system selects which skill to read ( Yan et al., 2026 ) ; as a skill pool keeps growing, its pass rate first rises and then falls ( Shang et al., 2026 ) ; and reflective memory can lower success relative to a memory-free retry in some settings ( Bai et al., 2026 ) . These studies characterize change mainly through aggregate performance over tasks, episodes, or checkpoints; we refer to this as outcome analysis. Outcome analysis can reveal gains, regressions, and retention, and combined with interventions it can also test whether performance depends on artifacts.

paragraphs.en: Our object of diagnosis is capability formation itself: whether a frozen system can turn behavioral change into task capability. We decompose this transition into sequentially dependent properties (Section 3.1 ) and pair each with independently assessable evidence: move differences and rule-based judgments in state-level diagnosis, call traces in game-level diagnosis, and newly passing and lost states in lineage-level diagnosis. Within this framework, the two bottlenecks identified by Agent Plasticity correspond to behavioral activation and task-relation realization, whereas the breaks in Reflexion, Voyager, and DGM fall at task-relation realization, boundary-safe reuse, and capability extension. Additional related work appears in Appendix G .
paragraphs.zh: 我们诊断的对象是能力形成本身：一个冻结系统能否将行为变化转化为任务能力。 我们将这一转化分解为依次依赖的属性（第 3.1 节），并为每一属性配以可独立评估的证据：状态级诊断中的移动差异与基于规则的判定，博弈级诊断中的调用轨迹，以及谱系级诊断中新增通过和丢失的状态。 在该框架内，Agent Plasticity 所识别的两个瓶颈对应于行为激活与任务关系实现，而 Reflexion、Voyager 和 DGM 的断裂则分别落在任务关系实现、边界安全复用与能力扩展上。 其他相关工作见附录 G。

sents.en: We define five properties along the stages an artifact passes through to become a capability:
sents.zh: 我们沿制品成为能力所经历的各个阶段定义了五个性质：

paragraphs.en: Artifact formation : a persistent structure has formed and is connected to subsequent decision making;
paragraphs.zh: 工件形成：已形成一个持久性结构，并与后续决策建立连接；

paragraphs.en: Behavioral activation : under the same state and interface conditions, actions with and without the artifact differ by more than sampling noise;
paragraphs.zh: 行为激活：在相同的状态与接口条件下，使用该人工制品与不使用该人工制品的行为差异超出抽样噪声；

paragraphs.en: Task-relation realization : the artifact produces a positive effect—the resulting actions better satisfy the relevant task relation overall, rather than merely differing from the original ones;
paragraphs.zh: 任务关系实现：该人工物产生积极效果——由此产生的行动总体上更好地满足相关任务关系，而非仅仅与原有行动有所不同；

paragraphs.en: Boundary-safe reuse : the artifact does not undermine an established effect—in actual decision making, an established positive relation is not overturned by another part of the system;
paragraphs.zh: 边界安全复用：该产物不会破坏已确立的效应——在实际决策中，已确立的正向关系不会被系统的另一部分推翻；

paragraphs.en: Capability extension : a later version adds new positive effects while preserving existing ones.
paragraphs.zh: 能力扩展：后续版本在保留既有正面效果的同时新增了正面效果。

paragraphs.en: The dependency structure is 1 → 2 → ( 3 ​ and ​ 4 ) → 5 1\rightarrow 2\rightarrow(3\text{ and }4)\rightarrow 5 ; we call this sequence the capability chain . Properties 3 and 4 form a single checkpoint : the former asks whether the artifact produces a positive effect, the latter whether it undermines an established one. When both hold, we say that capability formation has occurred. Property 4 concerns only established positive relations that are overturned in actual decisions; gains and losses on fixed states already count toward Property 3. Property 5 is meaningful only for versions that pass the checkpoint. Diagnosis proceeds in this order: the first property that fails is the break , and properties that depend on it are not judged.

paragraphs.en: The five properties apply at three scales. Properties 2 and 3 concern single moves and are judged on fixed states; Property 4 concerns established effects in actual decision making and is judged in complete games; Property 5 concerns evolution and is judged along the version lineage; and Property 1 is confirmed directly from call records. Game-level diagnosis does not judge wins and losses as such, but whether an established effect is overturned.

paragraphs.en: A task relation is defined by the task objective: it specifies which actions advance the task in a given state, such as taking one’s own immediate winning point, blocking the opponent’s, or forming an open four. Environmental rules, such as not playing on an occupied point, are not task relations: every legal action satisfies them, yet they advance nothing. Property 3 therefore compares only legal actions; reducing rule violations does not by itself count as a positive effect.
paragraphs.zh: 任务关系由任务目标定义：它规定在给定状态下哪些行动能推进任务，例如占据自己的即胜点、阻挡对手的即胜点，或形成活四。 环境规则（如不能下在已被占据的点上）不属于任务关系：每个合法行动都满足这些规则，但它们并不推进任何东西。 因此，性质3只在合法行动之间进行比较；仅仅减少违反规则的行为本身不算作正面效果。

paragraphs.en: Our object of diagnosis is the frozen system : all artifacts that actually participate in decision making in a frozen version, taken as a whole. Decisions are produced jointly by several components : skills propose candidates, a calling script decides which skill to query first and which answer to accept, and code branches override one another. A component may be correct on its own yet have its effect overturned by another once they are combined. With single components as the unit, a failure could only be blamed on “a poorly written skill,” leaving open whether the system as a whole has formed a capability. We therefore judge Properties 1–4 on the frozen system; which component a break lies in serves only as explanation and does not change the judgment. Formal definitions appear in Appendix A .

paragraphs.en: Three properties of the environment make three-scale diagnosis possible (Figure 3 ). paragraphs.en: State-level diagnosis. We use 1,876 fixed states: set A contains 120 states obtained by rotating and reflecting manually constructed tactical states, and set B contains 1,756 states drawn from actual games during DGM evolution (construction in Appendix B ). The control removes the artifact under test: empty memory for Reflexion; round1 for Voyager, which keeps only the first-round tactical skills and leaves the calling script unchanged; and the agent’s initial strategy P0 for DGM. paragraphs.zh: 状态层面的诊断。 我们使用 1,876 个固定状态：集合 A 包含通过对人工构建的战术状态进行旋转和翻转得到的 120 个状态，集合 B 包含从 DGM 进化过程中实际对局中抽取的 1,756 个状态（构建方法见附录 B）。 该对照移除了被测的产物：对 Reflexion 而言是空记忆；对 Voyager 而言是第一轮的结果，即仅保留第一轮的战术技能而保持调用脚本不变；对 DGM 而言是智能体的初始策略 P0。 因此，对于 Voyager 和 DGM，我们检验的是进化所添加内容的效果。 由于 Reflexion 对其走法进行了采样，我们使用两次空记忆运行之间的差异作为噪声基线。

paragraphs.en: The three mechanisms cover three artifact forms; implementation details are in Appendix F . Reflexion writes game feedback into textual memories, split by opponent and feedback type ( outcome gives only the result; trace adds the full move sequence) into six cells of seven entries each, all of which we test; the model chooses moves directly. Voyager writes experience as executable skills that only detect board features or propose candidates; for example, detect_immediate_wins finds immediate winning points, and create_open_three proposes attacking moves that form an open three. The final move is chosen by auto_player , a calling script that the agent writes itself; it queries skills in a fixed order and returns as soon as one fires. DGM modifies strategy code directly, producing the lineage P0 → \rightarrow OB-1 → \rightarrow OB-2 → \rightarrow OB-3 → \rightarrow OB-5 → \rightarrow OB-6 → \rightarrow OB-7 (OB-4 is a side branch).

paragraphs.en: Although derived in Gomoku, the properties concern task relations rather than the game; we conjecture, without having tested it, that the same breaks arise wherever artifacts are reused through a fixed interface. Consider a GUI agent with two skills. Skill A moves the cursor to a target element and clicks; it can reach the target (a positive effect), land on a non-interactive region (an ineffective change), or open an unrelated page (a harmful change), and a version that only repairs malformed coordinates would yield a legalization gain. Skill B, written for pages behind a pop-up, first clicks to dismiss the pop-up and then moves to its own target. Each skill reaches its target alone, but when B runs after A, its first click hits whatever lies under the cursor on the page A just reached and navigates away: a compositional override of A’s established effect. Testing this requires replayable screens and a rule-based checker of application state (Section 4.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 尽管这些性质是在五子棋中推导得出的，但它们涉及的是任务关系而非该游戏本身；我们在未经检验的情况下推测，凡是通过固定接口复用工件之处，都会出现同样的破坏。 考虑一个拥有两项技能的 GUI 智能体。 技能 A 将光标移动到目标元素并点击；它可能到达目标（正面效果）、落在非交互区域（无效变化），或打开一个无关页面（有害变化），而一个只修复错误坐标的版本会带来合法化收益。 技能 B 是为带有弹窗的页面编写的，它先点击以关闭弹窗，再移动到自己的目标。 每项技能单独运行时都能到达目标，但当 B 在 A 之后运行时，它的第一次点击会命中 A 刚刚到达的页面上光标所在的任意位置并跳转离开：这是对 A 已建立效果的组合性覆盖。 对此进行测试需要可重放的屏幕以及一个基于规则的应用状态检查器（第 4.1 节）。

paragraphs.en: Most work supports self-evolving methods with artifact accumulation, behavioral change, and metric gains—signal-based evaluation—without defining what counts as capability formation. We define the transition from artifact to capability as five properties and judge them with three-scale diagnosis. Under the same base model, environment, and opponents, the diagnosis detects three capability-formation breaks: a legalization gain in Reflexion, a compositional override in Voyager, and loss-only drift in DGM. These counterexamples show that the three signals are useful but insufficient to determine whether a capability has formed. Evaluating the benefits of self-evolution requires directly testing positive effects, the preservation of established effects, and extension across versions, at the state, game, and lineage levels.
paragraphs.zh: 大多数工作支持带有产物积累、行为变化和指标提升的自进化方法——即基于信号的评估——却没有定义什么才算能力形成。 我们将从事物到能力的转变定义为五个属性，并用三尺度诊断来判断它们。 在相同的基础模型、环境和对手下，该诊断检测到三处能力形成的中断：Reflexion 中的合法化收益、Voyager 中的组合性覆盖，以及 DGM 中仅有损失的漂移。 这些反例表明，这三种信号虽然有用，但不足以判定一项能力是否已经形成。 评估自进化的收益需要直接检验正向效果、已有效果的保持，以及跨版本的扩展，涵盖状态、博弈和谱系三个层面。

paragraphs.en: How the three break types are distributed across mechanisms and tasks requires diagnosis at a larger scale. We cover three representative self-evolving mechanisms, whose artifacts are textual memories, executable skill libraries, and code-version lineages, but not every form of self-evolution: multi-agent co-evolution or direct parameter updates may break at other stages. Which properties can be judged also depends on a mechanism’s structure; for example, capability extension can be judged only for mechanisms with a version lineage. During diagnosis, Reflexion chooses moves with the model directly, whereas Voyager and DGM use evolved code. Whether different base models, longer evolution, or repeated runs would move the breaks elsewhere remains to be tested.
paragraphs.zh: 三类断裂类型在机制与任务中的分布情况需要在更大规模上进行诊断。 我们覆盖了三种代表性的自我进化机制，其产物分别是文本记忆、可执行的技能库和代码版本谱系，但并非涵盖所有自我进化形式：多智能体共同进化或直接的参数更新可能在其他阶段发生断裂。 哪些属性可以被评判也取决于机制的结构；例如，能力扩展只能对具有版本谱系的机制进行评判。 在诊断过程中，Reflexion 由模型直接选择行动，而 Voyager 和 DGM 则使用进化后的代码。 更换不同的基础模型、延长进化时间或多次重复运行是否会使断裂发生在其他位置，仍有待检验。

paragraphs.en: Finally, our empirical scope is limited to freestyle Gomoku. paragraphs.en: An independent rule-based referee checks the legality and outcome of every move. When the agent has an immediate winning point and it is its turn, the uniquely correct move under the rules is to complete five, even if the opponent also has an immediate winning point: completing five ends the game immediately, whereas blocking only allows the game to continue.
paragraphs.zh: 一个基于规则的独立裁判负责检查每一步棋的合法性与结果。 当智能体已经有一个即胜点且轮到它落子时，规则下唯一正确的着法是连成五子，即使对手也有一个即胜点：连成五子会立即结束对局，而封堵只会让对局继续。

paragraphs.en: During evolution, the agent autonomously decides whether to retain each candidate and which version should serve as the parent for the next generation based on the evaluation results. paragraphs.zh: 在进化过程中，智能体根据评估结果自主决定是否保留每个候选版本，以及哪个版本应作为下一代的父代。 主谱系为 P0 → \rightarrow OB-1 → \rightarrow OB-2 → \rightarrow OB-3 → \rightarrow OB-5 → \rightarrow OB-6 → \rightarrow OB-7；OB-4 是从 OB-3 衍生出的分支。

paragraphs.en: The differential pool was constructed from 472 archived games collected during DGM evolution. After exact deduplication by board state and player to move, it contained 7,212 states. We then added the 22 tactical states before expansion into set A, yielding 7,234 states in total. We queried the move-selection function of OB-6 and OB-7 separately on every state. Their selected moves differed on only one state, consistent with the fact that OB-7 adds only one newly passing state on set B.
paragraphs.zh: 差异池由 DGM 进化过程中收集的 472 局存档对局构建。 按棋盘状态和行棋方进行精确去重后，该池包含 7,212 个状态。 随后我们在扩展前将 22 个战术状态加入集合 A，共得到 7,234 个状态。 我们分别在每一个状态上查询了 OB-6 和 OB-7 的走子选择函数。 两者仅在其中一个状态上选择了不同的走子，这与 OB-7 在集合 B 上仅新增一个通过状态的事实相符。

paragraphs.en: After OB-3, both OB-5 and OB-6 add zero newly passing states on set B. The issue is therefore not simply that later versions failed to return to the peak; they added no new passing states at all, regardless of the reference version. Using OB-1, which achieves the highest pass rate, as the reference leads to the same conclusion: the B pass rate only decreases thereafter (Table D.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在 OB-3 之后，OB-5 和 OB-6 在集合 B 上新增的通过状态数均为零。因此，问题并不仅仅是后续版本未能回到峰值；无论以哪个版本作为参照版本，它们都没有增加任何新的通过状态。以通过率最高的 OB-1 作为参照版本，也得出了相同的结论：此后 B 的通过率只降不升（表 D.1）。

paragraphs.en: The composite score and the diagnostic results show broadly similar trends across versions: from OB-1 to OB-3, both the score and the number of wins against search_2 increase. However, a local mismatch appears from OB-3 to OB-5: the score increases from 347.0 to 357.8, whereas the number of wins decreases from 19 to 9. This occurs because the game-length term in the evaluation function compensates for the decline in the win term. Thus, the composite score broadly reflects changes in version performance, but this local mismatch shows that a higher score alone does not guarantee improved task capability. Whether later versions preserve or extend existing capabilities must therefore be assessed using both fixed-state diagnostics and complete-game outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: 综合得分与诊断结果在各版本之间呈现出大体相似的趋势：从 OB-1 到 OB-3，得分以及对 search_2 的胜局数都在增加。 然而，从 OB-3 到 OB-5 出现了局部不一致：得分从 347.0 上升到 357.8，而胜局数却从 19 下降到 9。 这是因为评估函数中的对局长度项补偿了胜局项的下降。 因此，综合得分大体上能反映版本性能的变化，但这一局部不一致表明，仅凭更高的得分并不能保证任务能力的提升。 因此，必须同时使用固定局面诊断与完整对局结果，来评估后续版本是否保留或扩展了既有能力。

paragraphs.en: Holding all other skills and the calling script fixed, removing create_open_three still allows the system to form an open four in all 20 games and win all 20 games, whereas the full system wins 0/20 games. This intervention changes the subsequent game trajectories, but that trajectory change is part of the total effect of removing create_open_three from the full system. The results show that, with auto_player and the remaining skills retained, the system can still form an open four and win. The call traces further show that prioritizing the own-immediate-win branch in conflict states would also prevent the same failure path. Thus, the problem is not that create_open_three or auto_player fails to provide a positive contribution in isolation. Rather, their combination uses a call order that does not correctly handle conflict states.

paragraphs.en: All three mechanisms use DeepSeek-V4-Flash as the base model and evolve through games against the same three programmatic opponents: rule-based , threat-aware , and search_2 . paragraphs.en: Reflexion. Each opponent has a separate memory cell. After each game, the system generates one textual lesson from the game feedback and appends it to the corresponding cell. Each cell retains at most seven memory entries. For diagnosis, we use the frozen state after the seventh entry has been written. The outcome condition provides only the win/loss result, whereas the trace condition also provides the complete move sequence. At decision time, all entries in the current cell are included in the move prompt, and the model directly outputs an action. Our implementation does not retrieve, filter, or weight memories based on the current state.
paragraphs.zh: 反思（Reflexion）。 每个对手都有一个独立的记忆单元。 每局游戏结束后，系统根据游戏反馈生成一条文本经验，并将其追加到对应的记忆单元中。 每个记忆单元最多保留七条记忆条目。 为了进行诊断，我们使用写入第七条条目之后的冻结状态。 结果条件只提供胜负结果，而轨迹条件还会提供完整的走子序列。 在决策时，当前记忆单元中的所有条目都会被纳入走子提示词中，模型直接输出一个动作。 我们的实现不会根据当前状态对记忆进行检索、过滤或加权。

paragraphs.en: Voyager. The agent writes its experience as executable Python skill files. The frozen configuration contains seven agent-written files: seven skills and the calling script auto_player . Our diagnostic target is the complete decision system comprising the skill files and auto_player . Skills detect board features or propose candidate moves, but do not directly output the final action. auto_player invokes the skills in a fixed order and selects the move according to the branch that fires. During evolution, the agent modifies existing skills or adds new ones based on the previous round’s evaluation, then enters the next round with the updated skill library.
paragraphs.zh: Voyager。 智能体将其经验写成可执行的 Python 技能文件。 冻结的配置包含七个由智能体编写的文件：七个技能和调用脚本 auto_player。 我们的诊断目标是完整的决策系统，包括技能文件和 auto_player。 技能负责检测棋盘特征或提出候选走法，但不直接输出最终动作。auto_player 按固定顺序调用这些技能，并根据触发的分支来选择走法。 在进化过程中，智能体根据上一轮的评估修改现有技能或添加新技能，然后带着更新后的技能库进入下一轮。

paragraphs.en: DGM. At each round, the agent modifies the strategy source code to produce a candidate version. Every version exposes a select_move(board, player) interface, which the evaluator calls directly to obtain a move. Each candidate plays 5 5 , 10 10 , and 5 5 games against the rule-based , threat-aware , and search_2 opponents, respectively. A composite evaluation score determines whether the candidate is retained and which version is used as the parent in the next round; candidates that are not selected remain in the version archive. This process produces a code lineage from the initial strategy P0 to later versions.

paragraphs.en: BenchTrace ( Huang et al., 2026 ) truncates a test snapshot before the target failure occurs, lets each framework and the ReAct baseline continue from the same prefix, and uses a rule-based detector to determine whether the failure is reproduced. It thereby measures failure-avoidance rate and also evaluates whether reflection can localize and diagnose failures. On Qwen3-32B and GPT-4.1, the end-to-end pass rate of reflection under this funnel-style, stage-wise evaluation is below 30%.
paragraphs.zh: BenchTrace（Huang et al., 2026）在目标失败发生之前截断测试快照，让每个框架与 ReAct 基线从相同前缀继续执行，并使用基于规则的检测器判断失败是否被复现。 由此它衡量失败规避率，并评估反思能否定位和诊断失败。 在 Qwen3-32B 和 GPT-4.1 上，反思在这种漏斗式、分阶段评估下的端到端通过率低于 30%。

It retains only items on which the two versions disagree and applies a one-sided exact conditional binomial test (equivalent to a one-sided exact McNemar test when λ = 1 \lambda=1 ) as a statistical admission criterion for the edit.

paragraphs.en: ExpWeaver ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) compares different timings for incorporating experience into decision making: not using it, using it only at initialization, using it at every step, and triggering it on demand. Its causal ablation either blanks out the retrieved content at the point where the agent triggers retrieval or randomly injects experience at the average trigger frequency. The outcome is measured by success over the entire trajectory. On Qwen3-32B, G-Memory, and ALFWorld, ExpWeaver achieves 83.33, compared with 75.37 when the retrieved content is blanked.
paragraphs.zh: ExpWeaver（Zhao et al., 2026）比较了将经验融入决策的不同时机：不使用、仅在初始化时使用、在每一步都使用，以及按需触发。 其因果消融要么在智能体触发检索的位置将检索内容置空，要么按平均触发频率随机注入经验。 结果以整条轨迹上的成功率来衡量。 在 Qwen3-32B、G-Memory 和 ALFWorld 上，ExpWeaver 达到 83.33，而检索内容被置空时为 75.37。

paragraphs.en: Xiong et al. (2025) finds that the more similar retrieved memories are to the current input, the more closely the agent’s output resembles the output recorded in memory. They also construct an “error-free” variant that keeps the retrieved examples unchanged but replaces the recorded execution with a correct execution, allowing them to compare the effect of memory-content quality.
paragraphs.zh: Xiong 等人 （2025）发现，检索到的记忆与当前输入越相似，智能体的输出就越接近记忆中记录的输出。 他们还构建了一个“无错误”变体，保持检索到的示例不变，但将记录的执行替换为正确的执行，从而能够比较记忆内容质量的影响。

paragraphs.en: ASSAY ( Wang et al., 2026c ) randomly masks skills on software-development tasks and estimates each skill’s effect as the mean difference in binary task outcomes for each “skill × \times task” pair. With GPT-5.1, 103 skills, and 15 development tasks, more than 90% of skills have a cross-task effect range greater than 0.40.
paragraphs.zh: ASSAY（Wang et al., 2026c）在软件开发任务上随机屏蔽技能，并将每个技能的效果估计为每个「技能 × 任务」配对在二元任务结果上的平均差异。 使用 GPT-5.1、103 项技能和 15 个开发任务时，超过 90% 的技能的跨任务效果范围大于 0.40。

paragraphs.en: Counterfactual Trace Auditing ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) uses dynamic time warping (DTW) to align stages in two independent trajectories, with and without a skill, and compares patterns of behavioral influence. The authors describe this comparison as descriptive rather than a causal estimand.
paragraphs.zh: 反事实轨迹审计（Zhou et al., 2026）使用动态时间规整（DTW）对齐两条独立轨迹（使用技能与不使用技能）中的各个阶段，并比较行为影响的模式。 作者将这种比较描述为描述性的，而非因果估计量。

paragraphs.en: Skill Following ( Cho and Park, 2026 ) computes the outcome difference between executions with and without a skill, restricted to tasks in which the agent actually retrieved the skill. On Math500, Llama-3.3-70B has an aggregate improvement of + 14.2 +14.2 percentage points, whereas this metric is − 39.4 -39.4 percentage points.
paragraphs.zh: 技能遵循（Skill Following，Cho and Park, 2026）计算使用技能与不使用技能的执行结果之间的差异，并仅限于智能体实际检索到该技能的任务。 在 Math500 上，Llama-3.3-70B 的总体提升为 +14.2 个百分点，而该指标为 −39.4 个百分点。

paragraphs.en: Library Drift ( Zhang et al., 2026d ) enables or disables different skill-library governance mechanisms at the full-run level and tallies each skill’s successes and failures in injection trials.
paragraphs.zh: Library Drift（Zhang et al., 2026d）在全流程运行层面启用或禁用不同的技能库治理机制，并统计每个技能在注入试验中的成功与失败次数。

paragraphs.en: Pelleriti et al. (2026) analyzes the types of code edits along an evolutionary lineage and replays saved generation prompts. About 30% of added lines exactly match lines removed earlier; after replaying 36 breakthrough events, the median score ratio is 0.76.
paragraphs.zh: Pelleriti 等人 （2026）分析了一条进化谱系中的代码编辑类型，并重放了保存的生成提示。 新增行中约 30% 与先前删除的行完全一致；在重放 36 次突破事件后，得分比率的中位数为 0.76。

paragraphs.en: These works use tasks, single-turn answers, full runs, aligned stages, or code edits as their paired or analytical units. Our unit of analysis is the frozen system. We pair comparisons on fixed states within multi-step games and trace how multiple components jointly affect the system’s control flow.
paragraphs.zh: 这些工作以任务、单轮回答、完整运行、对齐阶段或代码编辑作为其成对或分析的单位。 我们的分析单位是冻结的系统。 我们在多步博弈中对固定状态进行成对比较，并追踪多个组件如何共同影响系统的控制流。

paragraphs.en: Who&When ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) defines a decisive error step counterfactually: replacing the step with a correct action changes the outcome from failure to success. In practice, however, both human annotations and three LLM-based judgments are made by inspecting logs. On manually constructed systems, the Hybrid method achieves 12.28% step-level accuracy.
paragraphs.zh: Who&When（Zhang 等，2025）通过反事实方式定义了决定性错误步骤：将该步骤替换为正确动作后，结果会从失败变为成功。 然而，在实践中，无论是人工标注还是三种基于大语言模型的判断，都是通过检查日志来完成的。 在手动构建的系统上，混合方法达到了 12.28% 的步骤级准确率。

sents.zh: 然而，在实践中，无论是人工标注还是三种基于大语言模型的判断，都是通过检查日志来完成的。

sents.en: On manually constructed systems, the Hybrid method achieves 12.28% step-level accuracy.
sents.zh: 在手动构建的系统上，混合方法达到了 12.28% 的步骤级准确率。

paragraphs.en: Agentic Attribution ( Qian et al., 2026 ) fixes a target action, progressively reveals historical prefixes at the component level, and measures changes in the action’s likelihood. It also perturbs sentence-level context by deletion and retention to identify the components and sentences driving the action across eight trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: Agentic Attribution（Qian et al., 2026）固定一个目标动作，在组件层面逐步揭示历史前缀，并测量该动作似然的变化。 它还通过删除和保留对句子级上下文进行扰动，以在八条轨迹中识别驱动该动作的组件和句子。

paragraphs.en: We instead judge the task effect of each action with independent rules, and our intervention target is the frozen artifact set.
paragraphs.zh: 我们转而使用独立规则来评估每个动作的任务效果，我们的干预目标是冻结的工件集合。

paragraphs.en: GAMEBoT ( Lin et al., 2025 ) decomposes each turn in eight games into two or three subproblems and checks intermediate reasoning against ground truth generated by rule-based algorithms. In its experiments, GPT-4o achieves the highest average intermediate score, 0.52.
paragraphs.zh: GAMEBoT（Lin et al., 2025）将八个游戏中每一轮分解为两到三个子问题，并基于规则算法生成的标准答案来核查中间推理。 在其实验中，GPT-4o 取得了最高的平均中间得分 0.52。

paragraphs.en: Jung and Son (2026) incrementally adds manually designed harness layers in noisy Battleship and measures win rate. Adding the second layer raises the win rate from 50.0% to 74.1%; this layer does not call an LLM.
paragraphs.zh: Jung 和 Son (2026) 在含噪声的海战棋（Battleship）环境中逐步添加人工设计的框架层并测量胜率。 添加第二层后，胜率从 50.0% 提升至 74.1%；该层并不调用大语言模型（LLM）。

paragraphs.en: In Table G.1 , the “same-state action pairing” column indicates whether actions or outputs with and without an artifact are compared on the same decision state with a verified-identical input.
